# `csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks`

Allow a block the author wrote on one line to stay on one line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = true`

```ini
csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int X { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    public void Empty() { }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int X { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    public void Empty() { }
}
```
:::

::::

### `csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = false`

```ini
csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks = false
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int X { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    public void Empty() { }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int X
    {
        get; set;
    }
    public string Name
    {
        get; set;
    } = "";
    public void Empty()
    {
    }
}
```
:::

::::
